units.source_text: 同在箱根那次一样，名人生病，要求改变对局的条件，大竹七段不肯接受。

en.t: As had happened that time in Hakone, the Master fell ill and asked to change the conditions of the match, but Otake 7-dan would not accept it.

units.source_text: 七段比箱根那次还要强硬得多。

en.t: The 7-dan was far more unyielding than he had been at Hakone.

units.source_text: 也许是在箱根吃了苦头吧。

en.t: Perhaps he had learned a painful lesson at Hakone.
